scope: Pure composition, argv construction and handoff/classification checks; no agent or ticket script executed; no launch, Git or remote mutation.
checks: Composed input contains selected context, brief, current method and recorded decision
Later review and human-step instructions are absent from the current-step prompt
Editing the shared context changes the next composition without a chat-history input
Only the selected-context layer changes for that edit
Editing the brief and live method changes their next composed input
The existing ticket retains its frozen step sequence
Advancing the view to review selects that step skill
Launch argv selects the existing external CLI and passes the composed input
A human-assigned next step returns to the caller
An ordinary task has no deterministic phase by default
A reserved sibling script selects the deterministic phase without importing it
Dream uses the ordinary recurring launch alias
human_stop_reason: newsletter: next step hands off to editor; returning to caller
competitor_inspection: Upstream main source read on 2026-09-12; competitors were not executed in this probe.
